name: dsh-plugin-remote-use-slave
description: Build-time dependency manifest for the worker-side relay. NOT published, NOT needed at runtime.
//: WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: `slave/relay.mjs` imports the bare package `ws`, and it runs on a worker
that has no npm -- so the dependency has to travel WITH the files (the deploy script scp's
`slave/node_modules` to the worker). But `.gitignore`'s `node_modules/` rule matches at any
depth, so `slave/node_modules` is not in git: a fresh clone had the relay but not its
dependency, and `tools/deploy-slave.ps1` refused with 'node_modules present in the source'.
This manifest makes the missing step one command: `npm install --prefix packages/dsh-plugin-remote-use/slave`.
It is deliberately NOT in package.json's `files`, because it is a build-time concern: a
published package already carries `slave/node_modules` explicitly. A nested package.json that
shipped would also give `slave/` its own module scope, which is a resolution change nobody asked for.
